No. Each service has its own dedicated concurrency pool, so using TTS won’t impact your STT or Agent con ... Managed Agents: Credits for voice models: each plan includes a monthly pool of credits you can use for STT and TTS at their respective rates. Prepaid dollars for voice agents: today, in addition to credits for voice models, you also now get prepaid dollars per month to use towards voice agents at no additional cost. For example, the Scale plan, at $299/month, gives you 8M credits/month to use on STT or TTS models. On top of these 8M credits/month, you ALSO get $299/month to spend on Managed Agents. The free plan has $1/mo of prepaid dollars to use towards voice agents. Enterprise plans will have custom pricing. How many voice agent minutes do I get per plan? At a competitive $0.06/minute, these are the approximate agent call minutes per plan: Free Plan - 17 minutes. Pro Plan - 1 hour, 23 minutes. Startup Plan - 13 hours, 37 minutes. Scale Plan - 83 hours, 3 minutes. Note that these calculations do not include the costs for fully managed phone numbers. Please take these into account if you opt in. How many credits do I need? Sonic text-to-speech: One minute of audio generation requires 750-800 credits. 1 credit equals 1 character. Ink speech-to-text: One hour of audio is only $0.39 on the Scale plan. 3 credits equals 1 second of audio. How many credits do I need for Pro Voice Cloning? Training a Professional Voice Clone is free. Speech generated with a PVC costs 1 credit per character, unless your custom Enterprise plan specifies otherwise. How many Professional Voice Clones can I have? PVC slots are included with your pl ... ? Your subscription will renew monthly from your purchase date. If you purchase on March 31, it will renew on April 30, May 31, etc... What happens if I use more model credits than I have in my account? Paid users can turn on overages to go negative into their credit balance. Your overage rate will vary by your subscription tier. At pro tier, it's $65 per 1M credits. At startup tier, it's $45 per 1M credits. At scale tier, it's $38 per 1M credits. If your overages are off, new requests will be blocked if all your credits have been consumed. What happens if I use more prepaid voice agent dollars than I have in my account? You will continue paying at the same rate as your plan for voice agents. How and when are overages charged?
